chapters.Intro (Mizo): Rova chu Japan aṭangin Aizawl-ah a lo haw a. A pi chuan lâwm takin a lo hmuak.
chapters.Intro (English): Rova comes back to Aizawl from Japan. His grandmother welcomes him with joy.

chapters.Intro (Mizo): Khua a lo var a. An ṭhenawm Mami chu Rova hmu turin a lo kal.
chapters.Intro (English): Morning comes. Mami, the girl next door, comes to meet Rova.

chapters.Intro (Mizo): Rova leh Mami chu bazar-ah an kal. A pi chuan lei tûr a ziah sak a.
chapters.Intro (English): Rova and Mami go to the market. Grandma has written them a shopping list.
chapters.Culture note (Mizo): Aizawl-a Bara Bazar hi Mizoram bazar lian ber a ni a, thlai, sa leh puan an zuar.
chapters.Culture note (English): Bara Bazar in Aizawl is Mizoram's biggest market, selling vegetables, meat and cloth.

chapters.Intro (Mizo): Rova chu Aizawl sikul-ah a kal ṭan. A hreh deuh a, mahse a phur bawk.
chapters.Intro (English): Rova starts at a school in Aizawl. He's a little nervous, but excited too.

chapters.Intro (Mizo): Ka pi ui, Duma chu a bo! Rova leh Mami chuan an zawng.
chapters.Intro (English): Grandma's dog, Duma, is lost! Rova and Mami go looking for him.

chapters.Intro (Mizo): Vawiin chu ruah a sûr nasa hle a. Rova chu inah a awm.
chapters.Intro (English): It's pouring with rain today. Rova stays at home.

chapters.Intro (Mizo): Rova pu chuan lui-ah sangha man turin a hruai.
chapters.Intro (English): Rova's grandfather takes him to the river to catch fish.

chapters.Intro (Mizo): Vawiinah vantlâng hnatlâng a awm. Mi zawng zawngin kawng an tifai.
chapters.Intro (English): Today there's community work. Everyone cleans the road together.
chapters.Culture note (Mizo): Hnatlâng hi khawtlâng tân mi zawng zawngin hlawh lova hna an thawh hona a ni. Tlawmngaihna, lâwmman beisei lova mi dang ṭanpuina rilru nên a inzawm.
chapters.Culture note (English): Hnatlâng is unpaid work the whole community does together for everyone. It goes with tlawmngaihna: helping others without expecting anything back.

chapters.Intro (Mizo): Rova chu a damlo. A lu a na a, a khua a sik bawk.
chapters.Intro (English): Rova is sick. His head hurts and he has a fever.

chapters.Intro (Mizo): Pathianni a ni a. Rova chu a chhûngte nên Biak Inah an inkhawm.
chapters.Intro (English): It's Sunday. Rova goes to church with his family.
chapters.Culture note (Mizo): Mizote tam zâwk chu Kristian an ni a, Pathianniah kohhran-ah an kal a, hna an thawk lo ṭhin.
chapters.Culture note (English): Most Mizo people are Christian. On Sundays they go to church and rest from work.

chapters.Intro (Mizo): Rova leh a pu chu thingtlâng khuaah an kal a. Chu khua chu a pu pianna khua a ni.
chapters.Intro (English): Rova and his grandfather visit a village in the hills, where his grandfather was born.
chapters.Culture note (Mizo): Mizo chhûngkaw tam tak chuan thingtlâng khua an la nei a, an pi leh pute pianna khua chu an zah ṭhin.
chapters.Culture note (English): Many Mizo families still have a home village, and they honour the village where their grandparents were born.

chapters.Intro (Mizo): Chapchâr Kût a lo thleng! Lammualah mi tam tak an lâm a, khuangte an vua a.
chapters.Intro (English): Chapchar Kut has arrived! On the dance ground crowds dance and beat drums.
chapters.Culture note (Mizo): Chapchâr Kût hi Mizote kût lian ber a ni a, March thlaah, lo vah zawh hnuah hlim takin an hmang ṭhin. Cheraw (mau lâm) chu a lâr ber a ni.
chapters.Culture note (English): Chapchar Kut is the biggest Mizo festival, held in March once the forest has been cleared for farming. Cheraw, the bamboo dance, is its best-known dance.

lines.Speaker: Pi
lines.Says (Mizo): Rova, i lo thleng ta maw! I dam em?
lines.Says (English): Rova, you're here! Are you well?
lines.Right reply (Mizo): Ka dam e, Pi. Ka lâwm e.
lines.Answer to right reply (Mizo): A lâwmawm e! Lo lût rawh.
lines.Wrong reply 1 (Mizo): Ka in chu a lian e.
lines.Answer to wrong reply 1 (Mizo): Hmm, i dam em tih ka zawt che a nia.
lines.Answer to wrong reply 2 (Mizo): I lo thleng chauh a nia! I dam em?

lines.Speaker: Pi
lines.Says (Mizo): Thingpui i duh em?
lines.Says (English): Would you like some tea?
lines.Right reply (Mizo): Aw, ka duh e. Ka lâwm e.
lines.Answer to right reply (Mizo): Ka lo siam sak ang che.
lines.Answer to wrong reply 1 (Mizo): Thingpui chungchâng ka zawt che a nia.
lines.Wrong reply 2 (Mizo): Ka hming chu Rova a ni.
lines.Answer to wrong reply 2 (Mizo): I hming chu ka hre tawh e! Thingpui i duh em?

lines.Speaker: Pi
lines.Says (Mizo): Chaw i ei tawh em? I ril a ṭam em?
lines.Says (English): Have you eaten? Are you hungry?
lines.Right reply (Mizo): Ka ei lo, Pi. Ka ril a ṭam hle mai.
lines.Right reply (English): I haven't, Grandma. I'm very hungry.
lines.Answer to right reply (Mizo): Chuti a nih chuan chaw ei ang u.
lines.Answer to wrong reply 1 (Mizo): Mut ai chuan chaw ei phawt rawh.
lines.Answer to wrong reply 2 (Mizo): Chaw chungchâng ka zawt che a nia.

lines.Speaker: Pi
lines.Says (Mizo): Kan in hi i la hrereng em?
lines.Says (English): Do you still remember our house?
lines.Right reply (Mizo): Aw, ka la hrereng e. A danglam lo hle.
lines.Right reply (English): Yes, I remember. It hasn't changed much.
lines.Answer to right reply (Mizo): Kum tam tak i awm lo a, ka lâwm e.
lines.Wrong reply 1 (Mizo): Ni lo, ka in a ni lo.
lines.Answer to wrong reply 1 (Mizo): Kan in a ni ve tho, i pianna in a ni!
lines.Answer to wrong reply 2 (Mizo): Kan in chungchâng ka sawi a nia.

lines.Speaker: Pi
lines.Says (Mizo): I chau ang, khumah va mu rawh.
lines.Says (English): You must be tired. Go and lie down on the bed.
lines.Right reply (Mizo): Ka lâwm e, Pi. Zan nuam takin.
lines.Wrong reply 1 (Mizo): Ka chau lo, ka tlân ang.
lines.Wrong reply 1 (English): I'm not tired, I'll go running.
lines.Answer to wrong reply 1 (Mizo): Zan a ni tawh, tlân hun a ni lo!
lines.Answer to wrong reply 2 (Mizo): Ha ha! Khum hi mutna a ni, ei tûr a ni lo!

lines.Speaker: Pi
lines.Says (Mizo): Chibai! I mu ṭha em?
lines.Says (English): Hello! Did you sleep well?
lines.Right reply (Mizo): Aw, ka mu ṭha hle.
lines.Answer to wrong reply 1 (Mizo): I mut dân ka zawt che a nia.
lines.Answer to wrong reply 2 (Mizo): Ni lo, zîng a ni tawh e! En teh, ni a chhuak.

lines.Speaker: Pi
lines.Says (Mizo): Tukṭhuan atan artui i duh em, nge bawnghnute?
lines.Says (English): For breakfast, would you like an egg or milk?
lines.Right reply (Mizo): Artui ka duh, Pi.
lines.Answer to right reply (Mizo): Artui ka chhûm sak ang che.
lines.Answer to wrong reply 1 (Mizo): Tukṭhuan chungchâng ka zawt che a nia.
lines.Answer to wrong reply 2 (Mizo): Ha ha! Artui chu a thlâwk thei lo ve!

lines.Speaker: Mami
lines.Says (Mizo): Chibai, Rova! Kei hi Mami, in ṭhenawm nu ka ni.
lines.Says (English): Hi, Rova! I'm Mami, your neighbour.
lines.Right reply (Mizo): Chibai, Mami! Kan inhmuh hi ka lâwm e.
lines.Right reply (English): Hi, Mami! I'm glad to meet you.
lines.Answer to wrong reply 1 (Mizo): Ka inhriattîr che a nia. I hming i hrilh ve em?
lines.Answer to wrong reply 2 (Mizo): Aw… chu chu a zahawm lo deuh.

lines.Speaker: Mami
lines.Says (Mizo): Mizo ṭawng i thiam em?
lines.Says (English): Can you speak Mizo?
lines.Right reply (Mizo): Tlêm tê ka thiam. Ka zir mêk.
lines.Answer to right reply (Mizo): A ṭha e! Ka ṭanpui ang che.
lines.Answer to wrong reply 1 (Mizo): Ṭawng chungchâng ka zawt che a nia.
lines.Answer to wrong reply 2 (Mizo): Japan-ah i awm a, i hre ngei ang! Mizo ṭawng ka zawt che a nia.

lines.Speaker: Mami
lines.Says (Mizo): Naktuk zîngah bazar-ah kal ho ila.
lines.Says (English): Let's go to the market together tomorrow morning.
lines.Right reply (Mizo): Aw, kal ho ila. Ka phur e!
lines.Right reply (English): Yes, let's go. I can't wait!
lines.Answer to right reply (Mizo): Zîng takah ka lo kal ang.
lines.Answer to wrong reply 1 (Mizo): Naktuk tih ka sawi a nia, nimin a ni lo.
lines.Wrong reply 2 (Mizo): Bazar chu ka ui a ni.
lines.Answer to wrong reply 2 (Mizo): Ha ha! Bazar hi thil lei leh hralhna hmun a ni.

lines.Speaker: Thil zuartu
lines.Says (Mizo): Chibai! Eng nge i lei duh?
lines.Says (English): Hello! What would you like to buy?
lines.Right reply (Mizo): Alu ka lei duh e.
lines.Answer to right reply (Mizo): Alu ṭha tak tak a awm e.
lines.Answer to wrong reply 1 (Mizo): Ka lâwm e, Rova. Eng nge i lei duh?
lines.Answer to wrong reply 2 (Mizo): Kei hi alu zuartu ka ni a, i lei dawn em?

lines.Speaker: Thil zuartu
lines.Says (Mizo): Engzat nge i duh?
lines.Says (English): How much would you like?
lines.Right reply (Mizo): Kilo khat ka duh.
lines.Answer to wrong reply 1 (Mizo): Engzat nge i duh tih ka zawt che a nia.
lines.Answer to wrong reply 2 (Mizo): Tûnah i lei dawn em? Engzat nge?

lines.Speaker: Thil zuartu
lines.Says (Mizo): Hmarcha pawh i duh em? A thak hle.
lines.Says (English): Would you like some chillies too? They're very hot.
lines.Right reply (Mizo): Aw, pathum min pe rawh.
lines.Answer to wrong reply 1 (Mizo): Ni lo, hmarcha chu a thak!
lines.Answer to wrong reply 2 (Mizo): Hmm, hmarcha ka sawi a nia.

lines.Speaker: Thil zuartu
lines.Says (Mizo): A vaiin cheng sawmnga a ni.
lines.Says (English): That's fifty rupees altogether.
lines.Right reply (Mizo): Hei le, pawisa.
lines.Answer to wrong reply 1 (Mizo): Pawisa ka phût che a nia, cheng sawmnga.
lines.Answer to wrong reply 2 (Mizo): Ka hre e. Mahse pawisa pêk a ngai.

lines.Speaker: Mami
lines.Says (Mizo): Ka pi tân thil dang eng nge kan lei ang?
lines.Says (English): What else shall we buy for Grandma?
lines.Right reply (Mizo): Thingpui leh chini kan lei ang.
lines.Answer to right reply (Mizo): Pi chuan a lâwm ngei ang.
lines.Answer to wrong reply 1 (Mizo): Lei tûr ka zawt che a nia.
lines.Answer to wrong reply 2 (Mizo): Pi chuan thingpui a mamawh a nia.

lines.Speaker: Zirtîrtu
lines.Says (Mizo): Chibai! Tunge i hming?
lines.Says (English): Hello! What's your name?
lines.Right reply (Mizo): Ka hming chu Rova a ni.
lines.Answer to right reply (Mizo): Kan sikul-ah kan lo lâwm a che, Rova.
lines.Answer to wrong reply 1 (Mizo): I hming ka zawt che a nia.
lines.Wrong reply 2 (Mizo): Ka hming chu Sikul a ni.
lines.Answer to wrong reply 2 (Mizo): Ha ha! Chu chu i hming a ni lo ang.

lines.Speaker: Zirtîrtu
lines.Says (Mizo): Khawi aṭanga lo kal nge i nih?
lines.Says (English): Where have you come from?
lines.Right reply (Mizo): Japan aṭanga lo kal ka ni.
lines.Answer to right reply (Mizo): Hla tak aṭanga lo kal i ni a!
lines.Answer to wrong reply 1 (Mizo): Khawi aṭanga lo kal nge i nih tih ka zawt a nia.
lines.Answer to wrong reply 2 (Mizo): A ṭha e, mahse khawi aṭanga lo kal nge?

lines.Speaker: Muana
lines.Says (Mizo): Chibai, ka hming chu Muana. Ka bulah ṭhu rawh.
lines.Says (English): Hi, I'm Muana. Sit next to me.
lines.Right reply (Mizo): Ka lâwm e, Muana!
lines.Wrong reply 1 (Mizo): Ka ṭhu duh lo, ka mu ang.
lines.Wrong reply 1 (English): I don't want to sit, I'll sleep.
lines.Answer to wrong reply 1 (Mizo): Sikul-ah mut a phal lo ve!
lines.Answer to wrong reply 2 (Mizo): Ni lo, kei hi Muana. Nang hi Rova!

lines.Speaker: Zirtîrtu
lines.Says (Mizo): I lehkhabu keu la, phêk hmasa ber chhiar rawh.
lines.Says (English): Open your book and read the first page.
lines.Right reply (Mizo): Aw, ka chhiar ang.
lines.Answer to wrong reply 1 (Mizo): Ha ha! Lehkhabu hi chhiar tûr a ni!
lines.Answer to wrong reply 2 (Mizo): Keu tûr a ni, khâr tûr a ni lo.

lines.Speaker: Muana
lines.Says (Mizo): Chawlh hunah infiam ho ila?
lines.Says (English): Shall we play together at break time?
lines.Right reply (Mizo): Aw, ka duh e! Bawlung kan khel ang.
lines.Right reply (English): Yes, I'd love to! Let's play football.
lines.Wrong reply 1 (Mizo): Infiam ka duh lo, ka ṭap ang.
lines.Wrong reply 1 (English): I don't want to play, I'll cry.
lines.Answer to wrong reply 1 (Mizo): Ṭap suh! Infiam a nuam alawm.
lines.Answer to wrong reply 2 (Mizo): Infiam ho ka sawm che a nia.

lines.Speaker: Pi
lines.Says (Mizo): Rova! Duma a bo! I hmu em?
lines.Says (English): Rova! Duma is lost! Have you seen him?
lines.Right reply (Mizo): Ka hmu lo, Pi. Ka zawng ang.
lines.Right reply (English): I haven't, Grandma. I'll look for him.
lines.Answer to wrong reply 1 (Mizo): Ui chu a thlâwk thei lo!
lines.Answer to wrong reply 2 (Mizo): Ui kan hmu hmasa phawt ang.

lines.Speaker: Mami
lines.Says (Mizo): Khawiah nge kan zawn ang?
lines.Says (English): Where shall we look?
lines.Right reply (Mizo): Kawngpuiah zawng hmasa ila.
lines.Right reply (English): Let's look on the main road first.
lines.Answer to wrong reply 1 (Mizo): Khawiah tih ka zawt che a nia, engtikah a ni lo.
lines.Answer to wrong reply 2 (Mizo): Ui chu lehkhabuah a awm lo ang!

lines.Speaker: Ṭhenawm
lines.Says (Mizo): Ui dum tê, kawng kamah ka hmu e.
lines.Says (English): I saw a small black dog by the road.
lines.Right reply (Mizo): Ka lâwm e! Khawi lamah nge a kal?
lines.Right reply (English): Thank you! Which way did he go?
lines.Answer to wrong reply 1 (Mizo): Ka hmuh chu a dum a nia.
lines.Answer to wrong reply 2 (Mizo): Ui chungchâng ka sawi a nia.

lines.Speaker: Mami
lines.Says (Mizo): En teh! Lui kamah Duma a awm!
lines.Says (English): Look! Duma is by the river!
lines.Right reply (Mizo): Duma! Lo kal rawh!
lines.Answer to wrong reply 1 (Mizo): Ni lo, a lo kal turin ko rawh!
lines.Answer to wrong reply 2 (Mizo): Duma ko phawt rawh!

lines.Speaker: Pi
lines.Says (Mizo): Duma i hmu ta chu! Ka lâwm takzet e.
lines.Says (English): You found Duma! I'm so thankful.
lines.Right reply (Mizo): Mami nen kan zawng ho a ni, Pi.
lines.Right reply (English): Mami and I looked together, Grandma.
lines.Wrong reply 1 (Mizo): Duma chu ka ui a ni.
lines.Answer to wrong reply 1 (Mizo): Kan ui a ni e, ka lâwm e.
lines.Answer to wrong reply 2 (Mizo): I zawng ngei a nia, i hmu a lâwm!

lines.Speaker: Pi
lines.Says (Mizo): Ruah a sûr nasa hle mai. Pâwnah chhuak suh.
lines.Says (English): It's raining really hard. Don't go outside.
lines.Right reply (Mizo): Aw Pi, inah ka awm ang.
lines.Answer to wrong reply 1 (Mizo): Ni lo, ruah a sûr a nia!
lines.Answer to wrong reply 2 (Mizo): Mizoram-ah tuipui a awm lo ve!

lines.Speaker: Pi
lines.Says (Mizo): Vawt i ti em? Kawr lum ha rawh.
lines.Says (English): Are you cold? Put on a warm shirt.
lines.Right reply (Mizo): Aw, ka vawt deuh. Ka ha ang.
lines.Right reply (English): Yes, I'm a bit cold. I'll put it on.
lines.Answer to wrong reply 1 (Mizo): Ha ha! Kawr hi hâk tûr a ni.
lines.Answer to wrong reply 2 (Mizo): Ruah a sûr a, a vawt alawm.

lines.Speaker: Mami
lines.Says (Mizo): Rova, ka lo lût thei em? Ka huh vek.
lines.Says (English): Rova, can I come in? I'm soaking wet.
lines.Right reply (Mizo): Aw, lo lût rawh! Mei bulah ṭhu rawh.
lines.Right reply (English): Yes, come in! Sit by the fire.
lines.Answer to wrong reply 1 (Mizo): Aw… a khawngaihthlâk e.
lines.Answer to wrong reply 2 (Mizo): Kei hi ka huh a nia, nang i ni lo.

lines.Speaker: Mami
lines.Says (Mizo): Ruah sûr laiin eng nge kan tih ang?
lines.Says (English): What shall we do while it rains?
lines.Right reply (Mizo): Thawnthu chhiar ho ila.
lines.Answer to wrong reply 1 (Mizo): Ha ha, chu chu a ni lo.
lines.Answer to wrong reply 2 (Mizo): Tûnah eng nge kan tih ang?

lines.Speaker: Pi
lines.Says (Mizo): En teh, khawdur a reh a, ni a lo chhuak leh ta.
lines.Says (English): Look, the gloom has lifted and the sun is out again.
lines.Right reply (Mizo): Pâwnah infiam thei tawh ila!
lines.Answer to right reply (Mizo): Aw, kal ula, mahse fimkhur ula.
lines.Answer to wrong reply 1 (Mizo): Ni lo, a tâwp tawh e!
lines.Answer to wrong reply 2 (Mizo): Chhûn a ni la, ni a êng.

lines.Speaker: Pu
lines.Says (Mizo): Lui chu a fai hle a, tui a vawt hle bawk.
lines.Says (English): The river is very clean, and the water is very cold.
lines.Right reply (Mizo): A mawi hle mai, Pu!
lines.Answer to right reply (Mizo): Kan ram hi a mawi e.
lines.Answer to wrong reply 1 (Mizo): Ni lo, a vawt alawm!
lines.Answer to wrong reply 2 (Mizo): Lui kamah kan awm a nia.

lines.Speaker: Pu
lines.Says (Mizo): Lên hi min lo dawn sak rawh. Sangha kan man ang.
lines.Says (English): Catch this net for me. We'll catch some fish.
lines.Right reply (Mizo): Aw Pu, ka dawng ang.
lines.Answer to wrong reply 1 (Mizo): Ha ha! Lên hi sangha manna a ni.
lines.Answer to wrong reply 2 (Mizo): Hlau suh, ka awm e.

lines.Speaker: Pu
lines.Says (Mizo): Fimkhur takin kal rawh, lung hi a nal a nia.
lines.Says (English): Walk carefully, the stones are slippery.
lines.Right reply (Mizo): Aw, ka fimkhur ang.
lines.Answer to wrong reply 1 (Mizo): Ni lo, i tlu ang!
lines.Answer to wrong reply 2 (Mizo): Lung chu a khauh alawm!

lines.Speaker: Pu
lines.Says (Mizo): En teh! Sangha lian tak kan man!
lines.Says (English): Look! We caught a big fish!
lines.Right reply (Mizo): Aw, a lian hle mai!
lines.Answer to wrong reply 1 (Mizo): Ni lo, sangha chu a hleuh a nia!
lines.Answer to wrong reply 2 (Mizo): Sangha a nia, ui a ni lo!

lines.Speaker: Pu
lines.Says (Mizo): Ka naupan laiin he lui hi ka hleuh ṭhin.
lines.Says (English): When I was young, I used to swim in this river.
lines.Right reply (Mizo): Pu, chu thawnthu chu min hrilh rawh!
lines.Answer to wrong reply 1 (Mizo): Ka naupan lai ka sawi a nia.
lines.Answer to wrong reply 2 (Mizo): Kan bulah a awm a nia!

lines.Speaker: Pu
lines.Says (Mizo): Vawiin hnatlângah khan i tel ve em?
lines.Says (English): Will you join in the community work today?
lines.Right reply (Mizo): Aw, ka tel ve ang.
lines.Answer to right reply (Mizo): A ṭha e, i tlawmngai e.
lines.Answer to wrong reply 1 (Mizo): Khawtlâng tân kan thawk ho a nia!
lines.Answer to wrong reply 2 (Mizo): Ha ha! Hnatlâng hi hna thawh ho a ni.

lines.Speaker: Ṭhenawm
lines.Says (Mizo): Bawlhhlawh i paih ho ang u hmiang.
lines.Says (English): Let's throw away the rubbish together.
lines.Right reply (Mizo): Aw, ka ṭanpui ang che.
lines.Answer to wrong reply 1 (Mizo): Ha ha, paih tûr a ni!
lines.Answer to wrong reply 2 (Mizo): Ka hre e, Rova! Min ṭanpui rawh.

lines.Speaker: Mami
lines.Says (Mizo): A upat tawh avangin Pi Thangi chuan a in panna kawng chu a ti fai thei tawh lova.
lines.Says (English): Pi Thangi is too old now to clean the path to her house.
lines.Right reply (Mizo): Kan va ṭanpui ang u.
lines.Wrong reply 1 (Mizo): Amah hna a ni, kei hna a ni lo.
lines.Answer to wrong reply 1 (Mizo): Mizo nunah kan inṭanpui ṭhin a nia.
lines.Answer to wrong reply 2 (Mizo): A kawng tihfai kan ṭanpui ang em?

lines.Speaker: Pi Thangi
lines.Says (Mizo): In tlawmngai hle mai, Naute u. Ka lâwm takzet e.
lines.Says (English): You're so kind, little ones. Thank you so much.
lines.Right reply (Mizo): Lâwm ngai lo, Pi.
lines.Right reply (English): No need to thank us, Grandma.
lines.Answer to wrong reply 1 (Mizo): Tlawmngaihna chu lâwmman duh lova ṭanpui a ni.
lines.Answer to wrong reply 2 (Mizo): In ṭhenawm ka ni alawm!

lines.Speaker: Pu
lines.Says (Mizo): Hnâ kan zawh hunah chaw kan ei ho dawn nia.
lines.Says (English): When we finish the work, we'll all eat together.
lines.Right reply (Mizo): A nuam ang! Ka riltam tawh.
lines.Right reply (English): That'll be fun! I'm hungry already.
lines.Wrong reply 1 (Mizo): Ka ei duh lo, ka haw ang.
lines.Wrong reply 1 (English): I don't want to eat, I'm going home.
lines.Answer to wrong reply 1 (Mizo): Ei ho hi hnatlâng nuam ber a ni!
lines.Answer to wrong reply 2 (Mizo): Ha ha! Chaw chu ei tûr a ni.

lines.Speaker: Pi
lines.Says (Mizo): Rova chu i hmel aṭangin i nawmsam loh hmel?
lines.Says (English): Rova, you don't look well. Are you sick?
lines.Right reply (Mizo): Aw Pi, ka lu a na.
lines.Answer to wrong reply 1 (Mizo): I hmêl en hian i damlo ang hle mai.
lines.Answer to wrong reply 2 (Mizo): I lu leh i taksa ka zawt che a nia.

lines.Speaker: Pi
lines.Says (Mizo): I khua a sik em ni? I pang a lum hle mai.
lines.Says (English): Do you have a fever? Your cheeks are very hot.
lines.Right reply (Mizo): Aw, ka vawt deuh bawk.
lines.Right reply (English): Yes, and I feel a bit cold too.
lines.Wrong reply 1 (Mizo): Ka khua a sik lo, ka tlân ang.
lines.Answer to wrong reply 1 (Mizo): Ni lo, i khua a sik alawm. Chawl rawh.
lines.Answer to wrong reply 2 (Mizo): Khawsik hi damlohna a ni.

lines.Speaker: Daktawr
lines.Says (Mizo): I eng nee nâ a?
lines.Says (English): What's hurting you?
lines.Right reply (Mizo): Ka lu a na a, ka khua a sik.
lines.Right reply (English): My head hurts and I have a fever.
lines.Wrong reply 1 (English): I used to live in Japan.
lines.Answer to wrong reply 1 (Mizo): Ka hre e. Mahse i natna ka zawt che a nia.
lines.Wrong reply 2 (Mizo): Ka natna chu sangha a ni.
lines.Answer to wrong reply 2 (Mizo): Ha ha, chu chu a ni thei lo.

lines.Speaker: Daktawr
lines.Says (Mizo): He damdawi hi ni thum chhûng lo ei phawt rawh.
lines.Says (English): Take this medicine for three days first.
lines.Right reply (Mizo): Aw, ka ei ang. Ka lâwm e, daktawr.
lines.Right reply (English): OK, I'll take it. Thank you, doctor.
lines.Answer to wrong reply 1 (Mizo): Ni lo, i dam theih nân ei rawh.
lines.Answer to wrong reply 2 (Mizo): Ni thum a nia, kum thum a ni lo!

lines.Speaker: Pi
lines.Says (Mizo): Chaw lum ei la, tui tam tak in la, chawl hahdam rawh.
lines.Says (English): Eat some warm food, drink lots of water and get plenty of rest.
lines.Right reply (Mizo): Aw Pi, ka chawl ang.
lines.Answer to wrong reply 1 (Mizo): Dam leh hmasa phawt rawh!
lines.Wrong reply 2 (English): I don't need to drink water.
lines.Answer to wrong reply 2 (Mizo): I dam theih nân tui in a ṭha.

lines.Speaker: Pi
lines.Says (Mizo): Pathianni a ni a, Biak inah kan inkhawm ang.
lines.Says (English): It's Sunday, we're going to church.
lines.Right reply (Mizo): Aw Pi, ka inpeih tawh.
lines.Answer to wrong reply 1 (Mizo): Pathianniah sikul a awm lo ve.
lines.Answer to wrong reply 2 (Mizo): Ni lo, Pathianni a ni.

lines.Speaker: Mami
lines.Says (Mizo): Biak inah hla kan sa ho ang. I zai ngai em?
lines.Says (English): We'll sing hymns together at church. Do you sing?
lines.Right reply (Mizo): Aw, ka zai ṭhin. Ka zai ve ang.
lines.Right reply (English): Yes, I do. I'll sing along.
lines.Answer to wrong reply 1 (Mizo): Zai ka zawt che a nia!
lines.Answer to wrong reply 2 (Mizo): Ha ha, hla chu sak tûr a ni.

lines.Speaker: Pi
lines.Says (Mizo): Chaw kan ei hmain ṭawngṭai phawt ila.
lines.Says (English): Before we eat, let's pray first.
lines.Right reply (Mizo): Aw, ṭawngṭai phawt ila.
lines.Answer to wrong reply 1 (Mizo): Nghak deuh phawt rawh.
lines.Answer to wrong reply 2 (Mizo): Ni lo, ṭhu rawh.

lines.Speaker: Ṭhenawm
lines.Says (Mizo): Rova! I lo haw chu ava lâwm ve.
lines.Says (English): Rova! We're so glad you're home.
lines.Right reply (Mizo): Ka lâwm e! Kei pawh ka hlim e.
lines.Answer to wrong reply 1 (Mizo): I lo haw ngei alawm, ka hmu che!
lines.Answer to wrong reply 2 (Mizo): Hmm, ka lâwmna ka sawi a nia.

lines.Speaker: Pi
lines.Says (Mizo): Pathianni hi chawlhni a ni a. Inah kan awm ang.
lines.Says (English): Sunday is a day of rest. We'll stay at home.
lines.Right reply (Mizo): A nuam e. Pi, thawnthu min hrilh rawh.
lines.Right reply (English): That's nice. Grandma, tell me a story.
lines.Wrong reply 1 (Mizo): Hna nasa tak ka thawk ang.
lines.Answer to wrong reply 1 (Mizo): Pathianniah chuan kan chawl ṭhin a nia.
lines.Wrong reply 2 (Mizo): Chawlh ni chu Thawhlehni a ni.
lines.Wrong reply 2 (English): The day of rest is Tuesday.
lines.Answer to wrong reply 2 (Mizo): Ni lo, Pathianni a ni.

lines.Speaker: Pu
lines.Says (Mizo): He tlâng hi en teh. A sâng hle mai!
lines.Says (English): Look at this hill. It's so high!
lines.Right reply (Mizo): A mawi hle mai, Pu!
lines.Answer to right reply (Mizo): Kan ram hi a mawi e.
lines.Answer to wrong reply 1 (Mizo): Ni lo, a sâng hle alawm!
lines.Answer to wrong reply 2 (Mizo): Ha ha! Tlâng chu lawn tûr a ni.

lines.Speaker: Pu
lines.Says (Mizo): Ka naupan laiin he khuaah hian ka cheng ṭhin.
lines.Says (English): When I was a boy, I lived in this village.
lines.Right reply (Mizo): Pu, i in kha khawiah nge?
lines.Answer to wrong reply 1 (Mizo): Ka naupan lai ka sawi a nia.
lines.Answer to wrong reply 2 (Mizo): Ni lo, he khuaah hian a nia.

lines.Speaker: Khua mi
lines.Says (Mizo): Lo lût rawh u! Ka thlai chin te an nih hi.
lines.Says (English): Come in! These are the vegetables I grow.
lines.Right reply (Mizo): A ṭha hle mai! I thiam e.
lines.Right reply (English): They're lovely! You're good at it.
lines.Answer to right reply (Mizo): Ka lâwm e. Tlêm ka pe ang che.
lines.Wrong reply 1 (Mizo): Thlai ka duh lo, a ṭha lo.
lines.Wrong reply 1 (English): I don't like vegetables, they're bad.
lines.Answer to wrong reply 1 (Mizo): Hmm, chu chu a zahawm lo deuh.
lines.Answer to wrong reply 2 (Mizo): Ha ha, thlai chu a thlâwk thei lo.

lines.Speaker: Pu
lines.Says (Mizo): Ngaithla teh! Sava an hram sa.
lines.Says (English): Listen! The birds are calling.
lines.Right reply (Mizo): Aw, a ri a nuam hle.
lines.Answer to right reply (Mizo): Aizawl-ah i hre ngai lo ang.
lines.Answer to wrong reply 1 (Mizo): Ni lo, sava chu a thlâwk.
lines.Answer to wrong reply 2 (Mizo): Ni lo, sava a ni.

lines.Speaker: Pu
lines.Says (Mizo): Khawpui leh thingtlâng chu, khawi zâwk nge nuam i tih?
lines.Says (English): The city or the village: which do you like more?
lines.Right reply (Mizo): A pahnih ka duh! Thingtlâng hi a reh a, a nuam.
lines.Right reply (English): I like both! The village is quiet and peaceful.
lines.Answer to wrong reply 1 (Mizo): Khawpui emaw thingtlâng emaw ka zawt che a nia.
lines.Answer to wrong reply 2 (Mizo): Ka hre e! Khawi zâwk nge i duh?

lines.Speaker: Mami
lines.Says (Mizo): Vawiin Chapchâr Kût a ni! I phur em?
lines.Says (English): Today is Chapchar Kut! Are you excited?
lines.Right reply (Mizo): Aw, ka phur hle mai!
lines.Answer to wrong reply 1 (Mizo): Kût ni a ni a, mut hun a ni lo!
lines.Answer to wrong reply 2 (Mizo): Ni lo, Kût ni a ni.

lines.Speaker: Pi
lines.Says (Mizo): He hian inthuam rawh. Kût niah chuan Zo thuam mawi takin kan inthuam ṭhin.
lines.Says (English): Dress up in this. On Kut day we dress in beautiful Zo clothes.
lines.Right reply (Mizo): A mawi hle mai, Pi. Ka lâwm e.
lines.Wrong reply 1 (Mizo): Zo thuam chu ka ei ang.
lines.Answer to wrong reply 1 (Mizo): Ha ha! Zo thuam chu hâk tûr a ni.
lines.Wrong reply 2 (Mizo): Ka ha duh lo, a chhia.
lines.Wrong reply 2 (English): I don't want it, it's ugly.
lines.Answer to wrong reply 2 (Mizo): Aw… Pi chuan a lo tah a nia.

lines.Speaker: Muana
lines.Says (Mizo): Cheraw kan kân dawn a, i thiam em?
lines.Says (English): We're going to dance Cheraw. Can you do it?
lines.Right reply (Mizo): Ka thiam lo, mahse ka zir ve ang.
lines.Wrong reply 1 (Mizo): Ka kân duh lo, ka ṭap ang.
lines.Wrong reply 1 (English): I don't want to dance, I'll cry.
lines.Answer to wrong reply 1 (Mizo): Ṭap suh! A nuam alawm.
lines.Answer to wrong reply 2 (Mizo): Ha ha, Cheraw chu mau lâm a ni.

lines.Speaker: Muana
lines.Says (Mizo): Khuang a rik hunah, mau inkâra zuan luh tur a nia.
lines.Says (English): When the drum beats, you jump in between the bamboos.
lines.Right reply (Mizo): Ka zuang ang! En teh!
lines.Answer to right reply (Mizo): I thiam e! I zir thuai hle.
lines.Answer to wrong reply 1 (Mizo): Ha ha! Mau inkâra zuan luh tûr a ni.
lines.Wrong reply 2 (English): I'm scared, I'll go to sleep.
lines.Answer to wrong reply 2 (Mizo): Hlau suh, ka ṭanpui ang che.

lines.Speaker: Pi
lines.Says (Mizo): Rova, Mizoram-ah i lo haw chu ka lâwm takzet e.
lines.Says (English): Rova, I'm so happy you came home to Mizoram.
lines.Right reply (Mizo): Kei pawh ka lâwm e, Pi. Mizo ṭawng ka zir zêl ang.
lines.Right reply (English): Me too, Grandma. I'll keep learning Mizo.
lines.Answer to right reply (Mizo): Ka tupa, ka chhuang takzet che.
lines.Wrong reply 1 (Mizo): Japan-ah ka kîr leh nghal ang.
lines.Wrong reply 1 (English): I'm going straight back to Japan.
lines.Answer to wrong reply 1 (Mizo): Aw… hun rei tak awm la!
lines.Answer to wrong reply 2 (Mizo): Ha ha! Kei hi Pi ka ni, nang hi Rova!
